name: EURUSD London Open: Green Probability by Horizon
description: Measures the probability of EURUSD posting a positive return after the London session open (8:00 AM London time) at three forward horizons: 5 minutes, 1 hour, and 1 day. Detects each London open bar, computes forward returns via lead operator, and reports hit rates, median returns, and event markers for each session open.
source:
# EURUSD London Open — Green Probability at 5min, 1h, 1d Horizons
# Detects 08:00 London time on 1Min bars, computes forward returns

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
ts = index()

# --- London Open Detection ---
# time_of_day returns minutes since midnight in the specified timezone
tod = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.time_of_day, timezone='Europe/London')(ts)
is_london_open = tod == 480  # 08:00 London = 8 * 60 = 480 minutes

# --- Forward Returns at London Open ---
# 5min = 5 bars, 1h = 60 bars, 1d = 1440 bars on 1Min data
fwd_5m = ((close << 5) - close) / close
fwd_1h = ((close << 60) - close) / close
fwd_1d = ((close << 1440) - close) / close

# Filter to London open bars only
fwd_5m_at_open = where(is_london_open, fwd_5m)
fwd_1h_at_open = where(is_london_open, fwd_1h)
fwd_1d_at_open = where(is_london_open, fwd_1d)

# --- Hit Rate (% positive) ---
# Ternary produces 1.0 or 0.0 on every bar, then filter to London open
hit_5m = where(is_london_open, 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_5m) and fwd_5m > 0) else 0.0)
hit_1h = where(is_london_open, 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_1h) and fwd_1h > 0) else 0.0)
hit_1d = where(is_london_open, 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_1d) and fwd_1d > 0) else 0.0)

# --- Reporters ---

# 1. PUNCHLINE — Hit rate by horizon (bar chart)
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='How Often Does EURUSD Go Green After London Open?',
    category='London Open',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    data_labels=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+5 Min', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+1 Hour', color=Color.Sky),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+1 Day', color=Color.Slate)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='50% (Coin Flip)')
    ]),
    order=0
)(hit_5m, hit_1h, hit_1d)

# 2. DISTRIBUTION — Median return by horizon (color by value shows direction)
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title='Typical Return Size After London Open',
    category='London Open',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+5 Min'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+1 Hour'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='+1 Day')
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=1
)(fwd_5m_at_open, fwd_1h_at_open, fwd_1d_at_open)

# 3. REFERENCE — Summary stats table
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='London Open Forward Return Stats',
        row_size=5,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['Event Count', 'Hit Rate (%)', 'Median Return', 'Best Return', 'Worst Return'],
        col_headers=['+5 Min', '+1 Hour', '+1 Day'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=3, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=4, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='London Open',
    order=2
)(hit_5m, hit_1h, hit_1d, fwd_5m_at_open, fwd_1h_at_open, fwd_1d_at_open, fwd_5m_at_open, fwd_1h_at_open, fwd_1d_at_open, fwd_5m_at_open, fwd_1h_at_open, fwd_1d_at_open, fwd_5m_at_open, fwd_1h_at_open, fwd_1d_at_open)

# 4. EVENT MAP — Mark each London open with forward return context
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='London Session Open',
        icon=Icon.GlobeIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='+5m Return', dp=4, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='+1h Return', dp=3, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='+1d Return', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(fwd_5m, fwd_1h, fwd_1d, is_london_open)
